regime_ewma_formula: lambda(origin,horizon)=0.93-delta*p_bear_month_horizon; p_bear is forecast average occupancy of the higher-Equity-volatility state.
delta_selection: Lowest one-month-ahead multivariate Gaussian NLL on common training-only rolling-origin forecasts.
covariance_scoring_center: Shared expanding mean of complete monthly returns available at each rebalance; used to isolate covariance forecast scores.
portfolio_execution: Multi_Period_Baselines.execute_first_period; exact first-period execution accounting and self-financing fees.
notes: The WP2.4 experiment changes covariance while holding expected returns and optimizer settings fixed.
The separate HMM-native experiment changes expected returns too; it is a whole-forecast-package comparison.
Plain EWMA and static rolling/shrinkage covariances are carried unchanged across horizons 1-3.
HMM covariance and regime-gated EWMA can vary by horizon.
No HMM script or existing MPO runner was modified.
